status_rule: All criteria are planned. Not run means no engine evidence; generator/data checks cannot mark a visual transition Pass.

groups.title: Land and space transition acceptance table
Shared navigation and community transition acceptance tables

transitions.trigger: Replay reference rain at M0, then advance to M1.
transitions.visible_change: Turf removal replaces the original cover; the M1 quantified outflow disappears.
pass_criteria: M0 reference rain retains 86.4 mm and the reference-station/model label.
M1 displays Not quantified for event runoff; no zero or interpolated runoff appears.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance through grading and compaction; replay the same rain independently at each supported state.
transitions.visible_change: Grading changes ground appearance; rolling changes activity but not the runoff result.
pass_criteria: M2 and M3 both show 1742.4 m³ managed drainage when rounded to one decimal.
The roller adds no runoff increment and the rain conditions stay identical.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to construction and opening; replay the same reference rain.
transitions.visible_change: Roof/hard-surface pathways replace prepared-ground pathways; tank routing appears only at M5.
pass_criteria: Managed drainage resolves to M4 2095.1 m³ and M5 2214.6 m³, each an independent event.
No interpolated flow curve, flood depth or automatic external repair runoff credit appears.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Switch from M5 to M6 while using the independent rain mode.
transitions.visible_change: Completed surfaces and rainfall response remain the same.
pass_criteria: M5 and M6 show the same event outputs and final surface allocation.
Event drainage remains distinct from operating wastewater and annual supply.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance through preparation to construction with water details open.
transitions.visible_change: Work-water activities replace each other; construction adds a contained-wash cue.
pass_criteria: Step site-supply totals read 50 / 1050 / 525 / 1988 m³ for M1 / M2 / M3 / M4, labelled whole step.
Offsite mixing is separate and raw washwater is not sent directly into the rain-drainage arrow.
No smooth demand-rate curve is inferred from unequal step totals.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance from construction to opening.
transitions.visible_change: Work-water activity ends; one-time commissioning fills/flushing are introduced.
pass_criteria: M5 selected site supply is 215 m³ for the commissioning step, not a recurring daily demand.
Construction wash/spray loops are removed; one-time fills do not run continuously.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to M6 and replay its operating view twice.
transitions.visible_change: One-time filling gives way to supply, evaporation and blowdown pathways.
pass_criteria: Average-day cooling labels show 300 / 225 / 75 m³ per day for supply / evaporation / blowdown.
Commissioning fills never repeat and replay does not add consumption again.
Other-user icons stay neutral; no shortage or utility-headroom result appears.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Inspect M0–M4, then advance to M5 without starting rain.
transitions.visible_change: The tank becomes available without an automatic event fill.
pass_criteria: No active campus tank appears in M0–M4; the tank becomes available at M5.
M5 availability does not imply permanently full storage or annual reuse savings.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.from_state: M5 or M6 before rain replay
transitions.trigger: Start an independent rain replay, inspect its endpoint, then replay again.
transitions.visible_change: Roof water fills an initially empty tank to the supported endpoint; remaining water goes onward.
pass_criteria: Each event starts empty and ends at 200 m³ captured, with 2214.6 m³ requiring managed drainage.
Reset is labelled a new independent comparison, not an actual simulated emptying/reuse cycle.
Intermediate fill frames are illustrative; no routed storm timing or annual supply credit is claimed.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance from stripping through grading to compaction.
transitions.visible_change: Tractor emphasis is replaced by excavators, then a roller.
pass_criteria: Selected fuel values remain 300 / 4320 / 900 L diesel for the respective whole steps.
Previous active machine groups do not accumulate into a permanent fleet.
Unknown electricity does not become zero and city-grid icons are not drained by diesel use.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to construction with energy details visible.
transitions.visible_change: Loader and temporary electrical-connection symbols replace compaction emphasis.
pass_criteria: M4 shows 6400 L selected diesel and 38400 kWh selected electricity with their work-step basis.
Fuel and electricity remain separate; no unsupported instantaneous electrical ramp or route is displayed.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to commissioning.
transitions.visible_change: Construction machines and temporary work activity leave; selected testing appears.
pass_criteria: M5 shows 20000 kWh for the selected commissioning step.
Unknown generator-test fuel stays Not established; construction machines do not continue running behind the tests.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to operation, inspect the split and replay.
transitions.visible_change: Testing gives way to continuous IT and supporting-system paths.
pass_criteria: The model shows 12 MW annual-average facility demand and 105120 MWh/year facility electricity.
IT 87600 and support 17520 MWh/year sum to the total; support is not labelled cooling alone.
12 MW is not a peak connection rating; no blackout, load ramp or accumulating replay total appears.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance from the original field to stripping.
transitions.visible_change: Turf disappears only from the selected campus works area.
pass_criteria: 3.2 ha become disturbed while 0.8 ha original turf remain; the campus stays 4 ha.
No tree removal, perimeter-track conversion or external verge area is added to the campus total.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance through grading, compaction and construction.
transitions.visible_change: The same worked ground is reshaped and rolled, then partly occupied by buildings.
pass_criteria: Cumulative campus disturbance stays 3.2 ha at every endpoint; no repeated land-take increment.
M4 surfaces show 1.2 ha roof, 2 ha bare ground and 0.8 ha original turf.
Qualitative ground changes do not acquire invented density, carbon or damage-depth readings.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to opening and play Building / Whole campus; inspect the ghost overlay.
transitions.visible_change: A 1.2 ha building outline expands in emphasis to the full 4 ha campus; original sports markings ghost through it.
pass_criteria: The reveal visibly includes supporting surfaces and preserves a recognisable site boundary.
Final cover is 2.8 ha sealed, 0.8 ha retained turf and 0.4 ha restored vegetation.
Original markings are labelled schematic; no verified lost-pitch count or public-access claim appears.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to operation and toggle before/after surfaces.
transitions.visible_change: The completed campus remains while recurring utility flows begin.
pass_criteria: Surface areas stay identical to M5; sealed and vegetated shares remain 70% and 30%.
Recurring activity does not consume another area increment or make retained/restored green space automatically public.
transitions.evidence_kind: scenario calculation plus authored animation

transitions.trigger: Advance to first heavy-access activity.
transitions.visible_change: Barriers and a signed illustrative diversion appear before the first vehicle; possible external verge wear begins.
pass_criteria: M0 has no construction barriers or wear patch; M1 shows their setup before heavy access.
The overlay is labelled Illustrative construction access and repair; no real route, dimensions or closure duration is asserted.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored qualitative scenario; no measured route or wear area

transitions.trigger: Advance through works and replay any middle step.
transitions.visible_change: Temporary access restriction persists with qualitative worn/flattened grass.
pass_criteria: The restriction/wear overlay remains through M4 and does not disappear between adjacent work stages.
Replay does not increase a damage-area counter or modify the 4 ha surface budget; retained campus turf is not silently damaged.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored qualitative scenario; unquantified external wear

transitions.trigger: Advance from construction to the authored handover scene.
transitions.visible_change: Heavy traffic ends, temporary barriers are removed, the schematic path reopens and verge repair starts.
pass_criteria: Removal/reopening and repair are visible actions, not an instant switch to a mature lawn.
The campus remains and the external repair is not counted in its existing 0.4 ha restored vegetation.
The scene does not assert an approved reopening plan or real-world safety assessment.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored qualitative handover scenario

transitions.trigger: Play the recovery replay, then compare the completed campus with the original field.
transitions.visible_change: The external repaired verge gradually becomes greener; permanent campus surfaces persist.
pass_criteria: A time-compressed illustrative-recovery label is visible; no recovery date or full soil-function claim appears.
Permanent sealed area remains 2.8 ha and repair creates no new water/energy credit.
Replaying or returning to M0 restores the selected state without accumulating damage or repair.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored qualitative recovery, not a calibrated ecological forecast

transitions.trigger: Follow the construction walkthrough with the contextual layer visible.
transitions.visible_change: Existing users remain present as access and work-service concerns are introduced.
pass_criteria: Scenario perspectives are labelled rather than presented as quotes or surveyed views.
Other-user service icons stay neutral: no dry taps, dimmed lights, depleted reserves or claimed allocation.
Drainage context appears only in rain mode; routes/capacity remain unverified.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored community-context handoff; no review of David implementation

transitions.trigger: Advance through handover to operation and open the related community question.
transitions.visible_change: The access question changes to long-term use while the permanent campus and recurring utility needs remain.
pass_criteria: Temporary reopening does not imply restored sports use, consent or verified permanent public access.
No displacement count, opinion percentage or utility shortage is derived from this transition pack.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored community-context handoff; actual views unknown

transitions.trigger: Select Heat for neighbours and preview the proposed connection.
transitions.visible_change: Reveal common recovery equipment and conditional heat pump; install schematic supply/return branches to the two fixed buildings and restore surfaces.
pass_criteria: The replay remains inside M6 with no new milestone IDs or implied baseline M1–M5 installation.
Exactly Anglers Lodge and Golden Gate Park Senior Center are fixed recipients; hypothetical connections and selected teaching values are labelled separately from real measurements or surveyed routes.
The teaching case uses a heat pump at declared temperatures without changing the original cooling concept; this is not a verified building retrofit.
transitions.evidence_kind: calculated educational heat packet; UI integration not assessed

transitions.trigger: Continue the heat proposal replay.
transitions.visible_change: Warm supply reaches both fixed buildings through isolated exchangers; cooler water returns through their return branches.
pass_criteria: Heat crosses exchangers while water particles remain within their isolated circuits; no datacentre coolant enters the recipient building-heating circuit.
Residual cooling, recipient backup heating and recovery-equipment electricity remain visible.

If checked heat figures are later integrated, label assumed demand and connections, thermal/electrical units and the fixed year. Recycled-water and green-roof concepts stay unquantified; UI integration is not certified by the data checks.
transitions.evidence_kind: calculated educational heat packet; assumption-based performance, UI integration not assessed

transitions.trigger: Use the single pair-wide Buildings need no heat replay, then restore demand for the pair.
transitions.visible_change: Useful delivery to both buildings stops while original cooling continues; restoring the pair-wide control resumes the proposed two-building state.
pass_criteria: Computing continues and original cooling rejects the heat when both buildings are unavailable; the demo uses one pair-wide control without per-building selectors.
The pair-wide replay never recomputes or accumulates annual figures; any later annual card remains a labelled fixed reference-year calculation.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored operating-mechanism replay; not a demand forecast

transitions.trigger: Select Recycled water, including immediately after heat or a numerical baseline view.
transitions.visible_change: Reveal the treatment, storage/pumping and schematic delivery chain.
pass_criteria: Concept preview label is visible and all numerical panels/hover values are absent, including baseline and previous heat/land values.
No treatment capacity, real cooling connection, exact route or reservoir fill is implied.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; no numerical assessment

transitions.trigger: Continue the source-path preview.
transitions.visible_change: Highlight the alternative supply branch while internal cooling and its outputs remain visible.
pass_criteria: The source changes visually while evaporation and blowdown remain; no claimed reduction in total cooling demand.
No numerical share, flow width or saving is shown and the alternative connection is labelled conceptual.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; service and capacity unassessed

transitions.trigger: Open the limitation beat, then reset the concept.
transitions.visible_change: Treatment/energy/quality questions are highlighted; reset restores the original-source illustration.
pass_criteria: No household shortage is shown as solved and no capacity upgrade is sized.
Alternative source equipment/route and quantitative overlays do not leak into the reset concept state.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; no calculated benefit

transitions.trigger: Select Green roof and continue to its cutaway.
transitions.visible_change: A schematic planted patch appears in constructed layers while equipment/service areas remain.
pass_criteria: Concept preview label is visible and all numbers/hover statistics are hidden.
The roof is not wholly planted or made public by default; no numerical planting area or percentage is invented.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; roof fit and structural design unassessed

transitions.trigger: Play the illustrative green-roof rain beat.
transitions.visible_change: Rain enters substrate; temporary storage and excess-water paths appear.
pass_criteria: Storage is finite and an overflow path is visible.
No measured retention volume, runoff/energy saving, calibrated flow width or baseline-water result appears.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; separate from quantified baseline rain replay

transitions.trigger: Switch to the illustrative dry-condition beat.
transitions.visible_change: Moisture fades and a vegetation-care cue appears.
pass_criteria: The scene is labelled illustrative conditions with no selected drying time, measured temperature or simulated weather year.
No automatic maturity, irrigation volume, biodiversity or carbon benefit is claimed.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; no calibrated vegetation response

transitions.trigger: Reset the green-roof concept.
transitions.visible_change: Restore the original roof and clear planted-layer, rain and dry-state overlays.
pass_criteria: Existing equipment/service paths remain, with no residual plants or rain/drying effects.
The reset concept stays free of numerical panels; leaving the selector restores the original baseline separately.
transitions.evidence_kind: visual concept only; reset does not demonstrate physical removal

transitions.to_state: Direct jump to M4 then M2
transitions.trigger: Use milestone selection without playing intermediate animations.
transitions.visible_change: Complete target snapshots replace the prior state.
pass_criteria: Surface allocation, machines, access overlay, labels and mode match the selected milestone without leftover objects.
M2 has no future roofs/tank/operating flows; M4 has no M6-only proposals.
transitions.evidence_kind: shared UI contract; verify in engine

transitions.trigger: Navigate backward, for example M4 to M1 or M6 to M0.
transitions.visible_change: Restore the earlier comparison snapshot instead of reversing physical processes.
pass_criteria: Comparison/earlier-state context is visible; no backwards water/heat flow or claimed instant ecological recovery.
Earlier surface and access states are restored, not gradually subtracted from a cumulative damage score.
transitions.evidence_kind: shared UI contract; verify in engine

transitions.to_state: Same target after Skip or Replay
transitions.trigger: Compare completed playback with Skip, then replay twice.
transitions.visible_change: Each route settles in the identical target scene and data.
pass_criteria: No duplicated machines, repeated resource totals, extra land take or persistent intermediate overlays.
Skipping preserves labels and default cards; animation duration is never presented as real work/recovery time.
transitions.evidence_kind: shared UI contract; verify in engine

transitions.trigger: Switch modes and repeat the independent event comparison.
transitions.visible_change: Rain, tank and drainage replace the operating overlay, then operating labels return.
pass_criteria: Rain remains an independent empty-start event; annual-average operation is labelled separately.
Drainage is not shown as cooling blowdown and captured event water is not deducted from annual supply.
No event or annual demand is added again on switching.
transitions.evidence_kind: mode and accounting separation; verify in engine

transitions.trigger: Select Heat, then Recycled water, then Green roof; leave the selector.
transitions.visible_change: Each proposal replaces the previous one; exiting restores the original M6 state.
pass_criteria: No combined pipes/plants/temporary works or summed savings remain after switching.
Both concept views hide all numerical cards, charts, badges and hover statistics.
Original M6 surfaces and baseline cards return only when exiting to the separate baseline view.
transitions.evidence_kind: shared selector contract; heat pending and concepts unquantified

transitions.trigger: Restart the selected case and replay its available phases twice.
transitions.visible_change: The proposal begins again from its defined original phase without state accumulation.
pass_criteria: Only one instance of proposed equipment/planting and its effects exists.
No installation duration, heat result or concept number appears through restart; each case retains its readiness label.
transitions.evidence_kind: shared selector contract; verify in engine

transitions.trigger: Advance from the original field to turf stripping.
transitions.visible_change: Original irrigation context gives way to a selected stripping work-water activity.
pass_criteria: M0 has no operating-campus cooling flow; its irrigation source remains unverified.
M1 introduces the 50 m³ whole-step work-water budget, not a daily cooling demand.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored activity and selected work-step accounting

transitions.trigger: Advance from the original field to turf stripping.
transitions.visible_change: A selected tractor and fuel symbol enter the scene before later work-machine replacements.
pass_criteria: M0 park energy stays Not established, not zero; the future campus has no operating load.
M1 shows 300 L selected tractor diesel for the whole step; no neighbourhood electricity effect is inferred.
transitions.evidence_kind: authored activity and selected work-step accounting
shared proposal interruption/exit contract; verify in engine
transitions.to_state: The requested phase endpoint after Skip
transitions.trigger: For each proposal, compare full playback with Skip during its works/layers/flow or weather beat; repeat from the same initial phase.
transitions.visible_change: Skip immediately restores the same settled phase endpoint as completed playback.
pass_criteria: Phase, equipment, labels and numerical visibility match the completed-playback target exactly; Skip does not silently select a different case or phase.
No unfinished trench, half-installed pipe, partial planted layer or previous phase flow/weather effect remains unless it belongs to the target endpoint.
No extra resource total, concept number or pending heat result is introduced by skipping.

transitions.evidence_kind: shared proposal interruption/exit contract; verify in engine
transitions.from_state: Any M6 proposal, including an in-progress phase
transitions.to_state: Direct jump to an earlier baseline milestone M0–M5
transitions.trigger: From each proposal and during an animation, select M0, M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5 directly in separate runs.
transitions.visible_change: Exit the proposal and restore the entire requested baseline state without playing physical reversal.
pass_criteria: All proposal equipment, pipes, plants, trench/weather effects, result panels and proposal-readiness labels are cleared; baseline labels and data visibility are restored.
Surface allocation, construction activity, temporary access state and default cards match the requested baseline milestone, with no M6 operating or proposal flow left behind.
Concept hidden-number state does not suppress baseline cards; M1 runoff remains Not quantified and other baseline unknowns remain Not established.
